headline: Texas Instruments recruits AMS verification engineers for Freising low-voltage buck converters
fact: Texas Instruments posted Design Verification Engineer requisition 25020204 for its SR-LVB product line in Freising, covering low-voltage buck converters and controllers. Assigned work includes UVM-based AMS/DMS pre-silicon verification, system-use-case simulations, Verilog-AMS and WREAL behavioral models, and closed-loop simulations combining analog models with RTL or gate-level designs and SDF timing. The role also contributes verification plans, testbenches and design-for-verification reviews. TI classifies it as Campus recruitment, not an internship. This is a hiring mandate, not evidence of completed verification results or a newly deployed methodology.

sources.title: Texas Instruments: Design Verification Engineer m/w/d (25020204)
sources.summary: The official public Oracle recruitment API gives ExternalPostedStartDate November 12, 2026 and RequisitionType Campus. The full description identifies Freising SR-LVB products and assigned UVM AMS/DMS, VerilogAMS/WREAL modeling and RTL/Gates+SDF closed-loop verification work.
